SCGSim prepares a geometry and solver request, then resolves the returned results with
their units and model identity. The complete component-simulation notebooks belong to
the OrcaPen SC PDK, which owns their components, settings and SCGSim environment.
Choose one by the quantity you need. For API parameter lookup and source-version
pairing, use the [knowledge guide](knowledge-guide.qmd).

## Choose a simulation {#getting-started}

Each row links the PDK notebook source at revision `49e539f`, the revision the
[home page](../index.qmd#install) installs.

| What you get | PDK notebook |
|---|---|
| A labelled conductor capacitance matrix for the SimplePad pad and Ground | [Palace Electrostatic](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_electrostatic.qmd) · [AEDT Q3D](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_q3d.qmd) |
| SimplePad mode frequencies, and the surface, bulk and branch energy participation of each mode | [Palace Eigenmode and EPR](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode.qmd) · [HFSS Eigenmode and surface EPR](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.qmd) |
| Per-unit-length C, G, L and R matrices of a finite-ground CPW cross-section | [AEDT Q2D](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_q2d.qmd) |

The PDK has no current notebook for the two-port S-parameters of the
finite-ground CPW; its HFSS Driven Terminal notebooks use the
[17-bridge CPW–meander coupon](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwMeanderAirbridge),
and the [Driven Modal](course/aedt-driven-modal.qmd) and
[Driven Terminal](course/aedt-driven-terminal.qmd) lessons prepare the
finite-ground CPW request.

Before you simulate a layout of your own, read the [supported scope](supported-scope.qmd): what the layout must guarantee, what SCGSim guarantees in return, and who owns a failure.

## Prepare a model and read its return

Start with [installation](course/installation.qmd), then select explicit geometry, materials, conductors and ports for your physical question. The [model and materials reference](reference.qmd#model-materials) and [conductors and ports reference](reference.qmd#conductors-ports) explain those choices. Use [returned results](course/returned-results.qmd) to keep the returned quantity, units, mode or conductor identity, and solver status together.

## Explore larger examples {#public-inputs}

The deeper Xmon and CPW source notebooks are pinned to public OrPen SC PDK revision [`49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85), the revision the [home page](../index.qmd#install) installs. It declares `orcapen-sc-pdk` `1.0.0`, imported as `orcapen_sc_pdk`, and GDSFactory 9.48.x. At this revision the PDK keeps its SCGSim examples under `SCGSimExamples/`; the Xmon sources and the CPW Driven Terminal source are in its `ComponentSimulation/` group. Use the source revision named by each example.

| Public notebook group | Use |
|---|---|
| [Kosen2024_Xmon](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon) | Palace Electrostatic/Eigenmode and source-first Xmon studies |
| [SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | HFSS Eigenmode, Q3D and Palace Eigenmode on the CPW coupon; its Driven Modal page records the settings only |
| [ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | HFSS Driven Terminal source |
| [SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85/notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | Q2D rectangles and conductor groups |

The source dimensions and presets are example model inputs. For current SCGSim requests, follow the relevant tutorial and API references.
